description: This figure group is a single rendered table (Table 4), not a plot or image, with four column headers printed as "Symbols", "Value", "Equation number" and "Reference". Twelve rows list the material parameters used by a 3D cellular automaton (CA) model of dynamic recrystallization in low-alloy steel. Exactly as printed: K (J/K) = 1.38 × 10⁻²³ [Eq. (30); Liu et al. (2024)]; C_drx = 1.99 × 10¹⁰ [Eq. (35); Appendix B1]; b (m) = 2.45 × 10⁻¹⁰ [Eq. (30); Xu et al. (2023)]; υ = 0.33 [Eq. (40); Wu et al. (2020)] — the caption renders this symbol as ν; E (J/mol) = 305,200 [Eq. (30); Appendix B1]; δD_ob (m³/s) = 5 × 10⁻¹⁰ [Eq. (41); Zhang et al. (2016b)]; A_GB = 37.5 [Eq. (30); Appendix B1]; H₀ = 2.63 × 10⁻⁷ [Eq. (30); Appendix B1]; P_GB = 2 [Eq. (30); Appendix B1]; n_GB = 2 [Eq. (30); Kocks and Mecking (2003)]; V_m = 7.18 × 10⁻⁶ [Eq. (36); Zheng et al. (2009)]; α_dis = 0.5 [Eq. (25); Zhang et al. (2016b)]. Several entries carry no unit in the symbol column (C_drx, A_GB, H₀, P_GB, n_GB, V_m, α_dis). Reference names are highlighted in blue. There is one table only, no sub-panels. The table's role is to document that every constant in the CA model is fixed and traceable to an equation and a source; all cells are legible.

observations.observation: Table 4 is a single four-column table headed 'Symbols', 'Value', 'Equation number' and 'Reference', containing twelve parameter rows.
The row 'K (J/K)' has the value 1.38 × 10⁻²³, is tied to Eq. (30) and is referenced to Liu et al. (2024).
The row 'C_drx' has the value 1.99 × 10¹⁰, is tied to Eq. (35) and is sourced to Appendix B1.
The row 'b (m)' has the value 2.45 × 10⁻¹⁰, is tied to Eq. (30) and is referenced to Xu et al. (2023).
The row for Poisson-type symbol υ (printed as υ, written ν in the caption) has the value 0.33, tied to Eq. (40) and referenced to Wu et al. (2020).
The row 'E (J/mol)' has the value 305,200, tied to Eq. (30) and sourced to Appendix B1.
The row 'δD_ob (m³/s)' has the value 5 × 10⁻¹⁰, tied to Eq. (41) and referenced to Zhang et al. (2016b).
A_GB = 37.5, H₀ = 2.63 × 10⁻⁷, P_GB = 2 and n_GB = 2 are all tied to Eq. (30); A_GB, H₀ and P_GB are sourced to Appendix B1 while n_GB is referenced to Kocks and Mecking (2003).
V_m = 7.18 × 10⁻⁶ is tied to Eq. (36) and referenced to Zheng et al. (2009); α_dis = 0.5 is tied to Eq. (25) and referenced to Zhang et al. (2016b).
C_drx, A_GB, H₀, P_GB, n_GB, V_m and α_dis are printed without units in the symbol column, unlike K (J/K), b (m), E (J/mol) and δD_ob (m³/s).
The caption states these are 'Material parameters in a 3D CA model'.
The citing text states that K, b, υ, δD_ob, n_GB, V_m and α_dis were taken from previous research (Koike et al., 2003; Liu et al., 2024; Xu et al., 2023; Zhang et al., 2016b; Zheng et al., 2009).

The citing text states that C_drx, E, A, H and P_GB were solved by a GA optimisation method detailed in Appendix B1 of the supplementary material, whereas the table prints A_GB and H₀ rather than bare A and H — the naming differs between text and table.

The citing text notes that some parameters were obtained by calibrating the constitutive model, including the characteristic stresses and the DRX activation energy Q_drx, though Q_drx itself is not a row of this table.
